metadata.purpose: Player identity and spelling lookup only; salary and team membership remain from the separate Spotrac snapshot.
audit_limitations: Full English coverage is checked against 520 salary IDs. Chinese labels are paired to those identities using public bilingual name sources, and 382 familiar spellings were manually reviewed.
Sources are mainly third-party bilingual rosters, not official NBA Chinese naming rules. Their spelling is retained as an alias; ordinary variants may differ.
Two detected Hupu Chinese-label identity errors were excluded and independently corrected. This is not an independent audit of every source identity; remaining source errors may still exist.
The 2026–27 Chinese display-name count is complete, while external evidence may use an alternative established translation rather than the exact chosen canonical spelling.
Short surnames and initials may identify multiple players. Alias collisions are preserved, including JB for Jaylen Brown, Jimmy Butler, and Jalen Brunson.

sources.use: Stable player IDs and exact English names only
Preserve existing known name spellings and nicknames; original 241 entries migrated or retained as explicit unmatched targets.

sources.description: Public Hupu bilingual NBA player rosters; not NBA official translations
sources.use: Chinese and English name pairing only; no salary or team roster updates.

sources.description: 15 missing roster names checked against Hupu profiles/draft entries and Wikidata Q13641280; 2 erroneous Hupu Chinese labels independently corrected using Qiumiwu/Funba bilingual name sources. Individual URLs are in provenance_by_player_id.
sources.use: Player identity and Chinese spelling only.

sources.description: Conservative manual review of familiar Chinese full names, common translation variants, and nicknames; no algorithmic transliteration of unknown names.

matching_policy.alias_collisions: Intentional many-to-many aliases must remain ambiguous unless team context uniquely resolves them.
matching_policy.normalization: NFKD, casefold, alphanumeric comparison in resolver; do not remove unknown given-name text.
matching_policy.english_name_coverage: Every salary record has its exact English full name; separate alias list adds observed or established variants.
matching_policy.chinese_name_coverage: Counted separately. The presence of a Chinese display name is not a claim about legal names or a single universally official translation.

metadata.unmatched_legacy_policy: These name targets have no 2026–27 salary record. Match an older salary snapshot only if that exact English identity exists; never substitute a current namesake.
